s0.ru: Многочлены Чебышёва второго рода в точке {point}. U0 = 1, U1 = {twice}. Дальше каждый равен 2*{point}*предыдущий минус предпредыдущий. Каков U степени {n}?
s0.en: Chebyshev polynomials of the second kind at {point}. U0 = 1, U1 = {twice}. Each next one is 2*{point} times the previous minus the one before that. What is U of degree {n}?

s1.en: Chebyshev polynomials of the second kind at {point}. U0 = 1, U1 = {twice}. Each next one is 2*{point} times the previous minus the one before that. What is the sum of U from degree 0 through {n}?
